activity.notes: After the Scottish victory at Stirling Bridge in 1297, William Wallace was appointed Guardian of Scotland. He resigned the guardianship after the defeat at Falkirk in 1298. ATLAS uses this documented public office rather than attempting to model the broader and less sharply bounded resistance career.

sources.title: William Wallace, Guardian of Scotland — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family account describes Wallace's appointment as Guardian after Stirling Bridge in 1297 and his resignation after Falkirk in 1298.
